marketSummary: The Indian equity market experienced a sharp intraday shakeout on Monday, November 23, 2026, breaking a four-week winning rally as the Nifty 50 slumped 450.95 points (-1.75%) to 25,349.65 and the BSE Sensex tumbled 1,483.72 points (-1.77%) to 82,435.99. Severe selling hit banking heavyweights and metal majors, amplified by Tata Steel's massive downstream consolidation announcement with APL Apollo Tubes and positioning ahead of the monthly derivative expiry. Bucking the broad decline, Nifty IT stood out as the primary defensive safe haven, advancing 1.69% on institutional rotation. With exchanges closed on Tuesday, November 24, for Guru Nanak Jayanti, swing participants face compressed rollover dynamics upon reopening Wednesday.
dailyFocus: Protecting swing capital following index benchmark breakdowns below short-term moving averages, tracking defensive rotation into resilient IT bases, monitoring structural re-evaluations in Tata Steel and APL Apollo, and tracking scheduled catalysts including CG Power's November 27 investor conference.

news.headline: Nifty 50 tumbles 451 points below 25,350 as banking and metal stocks spark broad sell-off
news.summary: Indian benchmark indices staged a sharp trend reversal on November 23, with the Nifty falling 1.75% to 25,349.65 and Sensex tumbling 1,484 points amid heavy profit booking across banking majors and metals ahead of the holiday-shortened expiry week.
news.impact: Widespread violation of short-term 20-DMA support levels forces capital preservation and tightening stops on high-beta long setups.

news.headline: Dalmia Bharat board approves ₹700 crore open-market share buyback at up to ₹1,850 per share
news.summary: Dalmia Bharat's board approved an open-market share buyback of up to 37.84 lakh equity shares (2.02% of paid-up capital) at a maximum price of ₹1,850 per share, representing a 19.3% premium to market price. The company committed to deploy at least ₹525 crore toward the buyback within 66 working days.
news.impact: Corporate cash deployment provides immediate downside price support near ₹1,550-1,560, offering a concrete pivot low for risk-defined accumulation.

news.headline: Tata Steel agrees to acquire 26.6% promoter stake in APL Apollo for ₹15,510 Cr alongside ₹28,000 Cr business transfer
news.summary: Tata Steel announced a major strategic transaction to sell its steel tubes and Tata Steel Colors businesses to APL Apollo for up to ₹28,000 crore in cash, while simultaneously acquiring a 26.6% promoter stake in APL Apollo for ₹15,510 crore at ₹2,100 per share and launching a mandatory 26% open offer at ₹2,301.40 per share.
news.impact: Intraday slump of nearly 10% creates a heavy overhead resistance zone, breaking multi-week base support and stalling fresh swing momentum.

news.headline: APL Apollo Tubes slumps 22% to 52-week low following ₹28,000 Cr asset purchase from Tata Steel
news.summary: APL Apollo agreed to acquire Tata Steel's tubes undertaking and coated products business for ₹28,000 crore to scale toward 15.5 MTPA capacity by 2035. The stock sank 22% to ₹1,655 in Monday's trading session over investor concerns regarding initial debt financing and deal structure.
news.impact: Decisive breakdown below multi-month price floors on extreme volume invalidates technical setups and mandates a wait-and-watch approach.

news.headline: CG Power's subsidiary CG Semi initiates commercial production at Sanand G1 OSAT chip plant
news.summary: CG Semi commenced commercial production at its G1 OSAT semiconductor assembly and testing facility in Sanand, Gujarat, delivering its first exported chip batch to Japan. The company has scheduled an investor conference call for November 27, 2026, to discuss operations and scaling.
news.impact: Operational milestone from commissioning to active revenue generation strengthens technical support near base swing lows prior to the Nov 27 call.

news.headline: Bharat Electronics bags fresh orders worth ₹619 crore for drones and defence systems
news.summary: Navratna defence PSU Bharat Electronics received additional orders worth ₹619 crore for communication equipment, drones, electro-optics, and system upgrades. This win follows a ₹909 crore contract secured in early November, driving its overall order book above ₹68,700 crore.
news.impact: Sustained order book expansion reinforces structural accumulation patterns near ₹400-405, showing resilience against benchmark market weakness.

news.headline: Nifty IT index climbs 1.7% in counter-trend rally driven by large-cap defensive inflows
news.summary: While benchmark indices slumped nearly 1.8%, the Nifty IT index gained 1.69% on Monday as market participants rotated heavily into technology defensives, led by TCS gaining 2.26% to ₹2,430.
news.impact: Clear sectoral divergence highlights technology leaders as priority candidates for relative-strength swing continuation setups.

news.headline: Trent crosses 1,340 retail stores with 1,000th Zudio addition amid leadership transition
news.summary: Tata Group retailer Trent Ltd reported a 22.5% YoY rise in Q2 revenue to ₹5,788 crore and opened its 1,000th Zudio store. Corporate lawyer Bahram Vakil assumed the role of Chairman on November 12 as Noel Tata transitioned to Chairman Emeritus, maintaining strategic store expansion targets.
news.impact: Steady store footprint addition cushions the stock, sustaining multi-month trendline support despite general retail same-store growth slowdowns.

news.headline: Defence Ministry seeks 20% CAGR hike in capital expenditure, brightening procurement pipeline
news.summary: Investor sentiment across defence aerospace improved following statements from Defence Secretary Rajesh Kumar Singh indicating a target 20% CAGR increase in capital spending for FY28. HAL recently announced a 16% YoY increase in Q2 net profit to ₹1,936 crore on strong execution.
news.impact: Policy tailwinds and solid earnings visibility provide strong buyer demand around the ₹4,730-4,750 base support area.

news.headline: Cochin Shipyard achieves keel-laying milestone for 70T tug following ₹500 Cr naval refit contract
news.summary: Cochin Shipyard executed the keel-laying on Nov 18 for an ASTDS 70T bollard pull tug for Polestar Maritime, complementing its ₹498.58 crore contract signed on Nov 11 with the Ministry of Defence for the normal refit and re-powering of naval frigate INS Betwa.
news.impact: Execution delivery across both commercial vessel lines and naval refit contracts reinforces an orderly consolidation base above ₹1,120-1,150.

news.headline: NSE and BSE shut on Tuesday, Nov 24, for Guru Nanak Jayanti; trading resumes Wednesday
news.summary: The National Stock Exchange and BSE will remain closed on Tuesday, November 24, 2026, on account of Prakash Gurpurab Sri Guru Nanak Dev. Equity and derivative operations resume on Wednesday, November 25, leaving a compressed window before monthly contract expiry.
news.impact: A midweek trading suspension increases overnight gap risk and accelerates rollover volatility into Thursday's monthly derivative expiry.
